title: Gandana Mane
desc: Gauri, a woman from a rich family, falls in love with Raja, a man who makes ends meet as a bus conductor.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: 1st Rank Raju
desc: Raju, a focused engineering student with little interest beyond studies, is pushed into real-world challenges that reshape his perspective on success and personal growth.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: A con artist starts interacting with ghosts when his partner in crime dies in an accident. During one such encounter, he stumbles upon a ghost who seeks revenge against his family's killers.

title: Naani
desc: Soon after moving into their new palatial house, a couple begins experiencing paranormal phenomena. An investigation leads them to the chilling story of the house's previous inhabitants.
